name: independent-review
description: Independent Claude and Codex review loops for GitHub pull requests and local code changes.

interface.longDescription: Run a read-only Claude or fresh Codex reviewer against a verified Git diff, validate findings locally, and converge on zero blocker and must-fix findings without broadening the change.
